frontier_act_119.text:
Grateful to cosponsor @GOPPolicy Chairman @JayObernolte’s Frontier Act which is a smart bipartisan framework to spur continued AI innovation with sensible regulation to eliminate catastrophic risk.

I’m grateful for Chairman Obernolte’s incredible work as @GOPPolicy Chairman.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says he is grateful to cosponsor the Frontier Act and calls it a smart bipartisan framework.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names the bill and identifies the speaker as a cosponsor.

china_race_dynamics.text: America has led the world in technological innovation for well over 100 years — from the airplane, to nuclear energy, the internet and beyond, and it is vital to national security that America lead in artificial intelligence as well. [...] AI can provide a large boost to economic productivity to the benefit of American families, and we cannot allow China to win the global AI race. I am grateful that the House of Representatives has just passed the “Ratepayer Protection Act,” which protects American ratepayers from higher costs associated with energy demands of data centers and large-load technology infrastructure.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the US cannot allow China to win the global AI race.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames AI competition with China as a priority.
